constructs.name: list.empty
constructs.documentation: Constructs an empty List<T>. T must be a declared closed type.

constructs.name: list.singleton
constructs.documentation: Constructs a one-element List<T> after checking the payload against the explicit T.

constructs.name: option.none
constructs.documentation: Constructs a typed none; the element type is always explicit.

constructs.name: option.some
constructs.documentation: Constructs a typed some after checking the payload against the explicit T.

constructs.name: result.ok
constructs.documentation: Constructs a typed ok; both result type parameters are always explicit.

constructs.name: result.error
constructs.documentation: Constructs a typed error; the inactive success type remains explicit.

constructs.name: list.map
constructs.documentation: Statically names one callback word with signature T -> U. The callback is type checked before any element is visited.

constructs.name: list.filter
constructs.documentation: Statically names one callback word with signature T -> Bool. Retains elements for true and drops them for false.

constructs.name: list.each
constructs.documentation: Statically names one callback word with signature T -> Unit and visits each element.

constructs.name: list.fold
constructs.documentation: Statically names one callback with signature Accumulator Item -> Accumulator. Visits items from left to right; an empty list returns the initial accumulator unchanged. The callback cannot capture caller locals.

constructs.name: match-option
constructs.documentation: Requires both cases. The some payload local exists only inside its case; both cases must leave identical stack and outer-local types.

constructs.name: match-result
constructs.documentation: Requires both cases. Each payload local exists only inside its own case; both cases must leave identical stack and outer-local types.
